# awx_workflow_job_template_associate_notification_template (Resource)

This resource cannot be imported because the import ID has no place for its `option` attribute. Declare it instead, and the first apply creates the association.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_workflow_job_template_associate_notification_template" "demo_workflow_template" {
  notification_template_id = awx_notification_template.demo_webhook_notification.id
  option                   = "started"
  workflow_job_template_id = awx_workflow_job_template.demo_workflow_template.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `notification_template_id` (Number) Database ID of the notificationtemplate to assign.
- `option` (String) Notification Option
- `workflow_job_template_id` (Number) Database ID for this WorkflowJobTemplate.
